const.reason: Phase 0 scenarios remain plan-only; only the separately declared RT-VLM/RT-Embed file-lifecycle canary has an executor.
Every current REST operation and MCP tool is assigned, but individual mutation ownership and exact cleanup semantics must be classified before execution.
The current Thor runtime has not produced fresh stateful acceptance evidence for this assignment.
Starting, stopping, or switching a VSS profile requires explicit operator approval and a restore plan.
Local model and profile startup must first pass the Thor memory-capacity gate.
The advertised upstream stream envelope has not been demonstrated on Thor.
The complete immutable Cosmos and alternate local VLM snapshot matrix is not staged.
Custom aligned warehouse videos, calibration, and model assets are not staged.
The auto-calibration backend image and optional VGGT refinement assets are not staged.
The immutable Nemotron Omni model snapshot is not staged.
A bounded loopback-only browser driver is not part of Phase 0.
Slack delivery requires a user-managed workspace, application, token, and destination.
Helm acceptance requires an operator-provided Kubernetes cluster.
Enterprise RAG requires an operator-provided external service and credentials.
The newly enumerated official documentation contracts have not produced exact current Thor runtime evidence.
Brev Launchable acceptance requires an operator-provided NVIDIA Brev environment.
Authentication, TLS termination, rate limiting, and external access controls require operator-managed infrastructure.
Named remote LLM/VLM acceptance requires operator-provided endpoints, credentials, entitlements, and hosting capacity.

The official VSS prerequisite requires native.cgroupdriver=cgroupfs; this Thor currently reports systemd and remediation requires an operator-approved Docker daemon restart that interrupts containers.
CARLA, RoadRunner, Isaac Sim, Cosmos Transfer, and associated training/simulation environments are operator-managed external dependencies.
